transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We have the proposed sale of our $12 million commercial receivables pool to Meridian Receivables Fund on the table. Their draft offer is $11.7 million with customary seller support for collection shortfalls. Before I can authorize this transaction and set closing conditions, I need each of you to report any unresolved items from your respective areas. Let's start with legal, then credit risk, servicing operations, and financial crime compliance. Who's ready to go first?
